productImport.title: Import & export products
productImport.subtitle: Add many products, or change prices and stock in bulk, from an Excel or Google Sheets file.
productImport.exportBody: A file with all your products, one row per variant (size or color). Edit it, then import it here.
productImport.fileHint: A CSV file up to 1.5 MB. In Excel use Save As, then “CSV UTF-8”.
productImport.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1.5 MB. Split it into smaller files.
productImport.unreadable: The file can’t be read. Save it again as “CSV UTF-8” and try again.

rules.rows: Each row is one variant of a product. For sizes or colors, repeat the product handle on one row per variant.
rules.match: A row whose handle matches a product updates it; other rows add new products, as drafts unless you give a status.
rules.columns: Columns you remove from the file stay unchanged, and the file never deletes a product or variant.
rules.images: Photos aren’t imported from the file. Add them in the product editor.
rules.baseline: Don’t edit the “Stock at export” column: it keeps sales made after you downloaded the file.
rules.all: The whole file is checked first, then imported completely or not at all.

issues.option_name_missing: Add the option name (such as Size) before its value.
issues.variant_not_found: Can’t tell which variant this row means. Use an existing SKU or add the option value columns.
issues.too_many_variants: The product has more than 150 variants.
issues.too_long: The text in “{column}” is too long.
issues.negative_stock: Stock would go below zero after the sales since the export.
